verdict.rationale: PayPal explicitly documents a self-contained sandbox environment that simulates production, directly matching the story's requirement to test without touching live data (paypal-docs-11), and the broader REST API/auth docs (paypal-docs-1, paypal-docs-18) support this sandbox testing flow for developers building against PayPal APIs, including AI-native agent integrations (paypal-gh-1, paypal-gh-2). missing for 10: no independent/hands-on corroboration of sandbox fidelity or edge cases, and no explicit mention of sandbox support within the MCP/agent toolkit flow specifically.
